d:
Hamne pal rakhe hain kaee khuda
Aur unke tathakthit mahant aur maulvi bhi
Hamne khol rakhi hai eeshvar ko pane ki dukanen kaee
Khuda, eeshvar, allah ko pane ki chah men
Ham gavan dete hai apni kamaee ka ek bara hissa
Us aastha aur bhagvan ke nam par !
Murhon ki jamat chhin leti hai
Hamare bachchon ke roti ke tukre
